case.note: The front draws R3.2 corners (photos 3.1; the K150 drawing R3). color is the front's case color at the top (photos #4b4b4c).

display.note: Active area datasheet-verified 2026-07-15: 14.86 x 24.91 mm (1.14", ~241 PPI, pixel pitch 0.1101 x 0.1038 mm, ~6% non-square); was 21.7 x 13.0 mm (~272 PPI, assumed square pixels). Origin photo-measured 2026-10-19: the vendor photo's lit boot screen spans 4.57-19.41 x 4.64-29.58 mm (14.84 x 24.94, the panel's size). Window opening in the case 3.92-20.08 x 4.08-30.18 mm.

buttons.note: Blue pill with round ends: its cap spans 6.25-17.86 x 36.50-38.60 mm on the vendor photos.
KEY2: its cap on the vendor's straight view of the right side.
M5PM1 power key, next to the USB end; read off two angled vendor views, about 0.5 mm uncertain.

notes: Portrait front view, 24 x 48 mm, the frame of svg/front.svg: x across the case, y down from the end above the screen. Dark grey case; the blue BtnA pill below the screen, KEY2 (BtnB) on the right edge, the power key on the left edge near the USB end, measured on the vendor photos (2026-10-19). The face has no print below the pill. width_mm of an edge button is not measured; height_mm is its length along the edge. extras[] carry no positions: the earlier estimates were in a landscape frame that did not match the photos, and the front draws none of these parts.
